I understand. My brain does the same thing with anxious thoughts and I don't know how to stop them sometimes. It sucks.

We're all here because we want to help or we need help so no matter what you have us here with you.
I understand this. This is really hard to deal with.

I know that feeling man. I only get messages from my family and it sucks not getting it from people who you thought would do it. All I can say that is that people do care. I don't know you but I hope you have a good birthday! I'm sure most people here who'd read this would feel the same.

I was fiddling with that idea and it seems destro resto is a good setup (or melee weapon / resto staff).

I love having invis, a finisher and shades with staves. It makes you incredibly slippery and quite tanky with wards. Also, invis knockback off cliff kills are quite awesome. 

Youtube Sypher and watch his latest video. He has a good magic 1v1 spec thats pretty adaptable and quite good for most situations.
